limitations: A path literal may be only a base path; dynamic concatenation must be resolved before implementation.
GraphQL records are deduplicated by kind, name and SHA-256 of the recovered document string. The same logical operation may still appear in multiple document variants. These are not endpoint counts.
GraphQL names and variable types do not establish complete input models, runtime availability, field schemas or client-side transformations. Referenced fragments may occur in other chunks.
Downloaded entry points and lazy chunks do not establish an exhaustive tenant-independent API specification.
Validation is specific to marked operations and fixture variants. External successful connector/webhook deliveries and non-generic exporter protocols were not tested.
One referenced Investigation lazy chunk (820.js) returned 404; five other Investigation chunks and the universal connector component were retrieved successfully.
